q1.expected_answer: JWT authentication and token creation are implemented in backend/app/core/security.py using create_access_token and create_refresh_token.

q2.expected_answer: Role-based access control is defined in backend/app/core/rbac.py with UserRole enum and require_role dependency.

q3.expected_answer: Sliding-window rate limiting is implemented in backend/app/core/rate_limiter.py with Redis and in-memory fallback.

q4.expected_answer: The AST code parser and intelligent chunker is implemented in backend/app/services/code_parser.py.

q5.expected_answer: The PR review agent is implemented in backend/app/services/pr_reviewer.py checking 8 dimensions.

q6.expected_answer: Multi-agent workflow pauses in AWAITING_HUMAN_APPROVAL and requires approve_patch before committing changes.

q7.expected_answer: Background jobs are managed in backend/app/services/job_manager.py and worker/celery_app.py.

q8.expected_answer: AI observability telemetry is collected in backend/app/core/telemetry.py tracking request_id, latency, tokens, and cost.
